release: D-Bus ReleaseSpace before every sample; require SQLite blob NULL and prior blob absent; never mutate database
clock: open/first byte/complete exclude child process startup; include complete native download verification and publication
cache: body cold locally, metadata/authentication warm; NAS/server caches uncontrolled
transport: loopback opaque relay with real NAS TLS; no imposed rate/loss/delay
interference: original six tasks and two probes; no fault/mixed load
hash_limits: compares with prior complete downloaded version, not independent server content oracle
stop_rule: stop on first failure, preserve and report unrun samples
